analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI 32.3으로 과매도 구간 진입, MACD 히스토그램 -2.8932로 개선세 보이나 여전히 약세 구간. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 1.31로 증가하며 하락폭 확대. 주봉 SMA100 68.14 근접. 현재가 $68.17은 주봉 SMA100 0.04% 상회하나, SMA200 대비 -45.13%로 여전히 큰 괴리. ADX 28.0으로 뚜렷한 추세이나 -DI 41.9가 +DI 17.6보다 우위. 52주 고가 $302.00 대비 현재가 $68.17은 14.6% 수준으로 극심한 하락세. 5일 연속 변동률 -11.52%로 하락폭 확대. 20일 저가 $67.50에 근접하며 지지력 테스트 중이나, 추세 전환 신호 미약. 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 3 consecutive trading days. RSI entered oversold territory at 32.3, and while the MACD histogram is improving to -2.8932, it remains in a bearish zone. The volume ratio to the 5-day average increased to 1.31, widening the decline. The current price of $68.17 is approaching the weekly SMA100 at $68.14, slightly exceeding it by 0.04%. However, it still shows a significant divergence of -45.13% compared to the SMA200. The ADX is at 28.0, indicating a clear trend, but the -DI at 41.9 is stronger than the +DI at 17.6. The current price of $68.17 is at 14.6% of the 52-week high of $302.00, reflecting an extreme downtrend. The 5-day cumulative return of -11.52% shows an expanding decline. The price is testing support near the 20-day low of $67.50, but there are no strong trend reversal signals. Maintaining a wait-and-see stance.
